Preston North End v Norwich City (Kick-off 12.30pm). Coverage of the Championship match from Deepdale. Will Keane proved to the be the hero for the Lilywhites when these teams met here last season, as he bagged the equaliser deep into injury-time in what was his first appearance of the season. The Canaries thought they had snatched all three points with five minutes left when Jovon Makama put them 1-0 up, but Keane's return from a long injury spell had the fairytale ending and secured a 1-1 draw.

Swansea City v Cardiff City (Kick-off 12.00pm). Coverage of the Championship match from Swansea.com Stadium. The Swans will hope they can continue to rely on their home form in South Wales derby matches, which has seen them win six of the last 10 fixtures in which they served as hosts, while suffering defeat on just two occasions in that same sequence. The most recent clash here was two seasons ago and ended in a 1-1 draw, when Liam Cullen gave the hosts a first-half lead but Callum Robinson equalised for the Bluebirds.

Hearts v Celtic (Kick-off 3.00pm). Coverage of the Scottish Premiership match from Tynecastle Park. The Jambos will be determined to avenge the 7-1 loss they suffered at the hands of the Bhoys in the most recent meeting at Celtic Park last month, which saw Celtic score five in the first-half and get five different names on the scoresheet during the full 90 minutes, with Benjamin Nygren and Callum Osmand each bagging a brace.
